indicators: GCS IAM policy binding 'allUsers' to roles/storage.objectViewer on sensitive bucket
Audit logs showing unauthenticated storage.objects.list operations
gcloud CLI successfully listing objects without authentication
HTTP 200 responses for GET requests to bucket objects from external IPs
Access from IP addresses not belonging to organization’s network
samples.detection_method: Implement continuous monitoring with Google Cloud Asset Inventory and Security Command Center to detect public IAM bindings on storage buckets. Configure alerts for any storage.objects.list or storage.objects.get API calls from unauthenticated or external sources. Enforce bucket-level uniform access and use IAM Conditions to restrict access. Employ Google Cloud Config Validator to enforce policy compliance.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1552.001 - Credentials in Files (exfiltration via public cloud buckets)
